K3.finding: A launch resumed with --resume-from tmp/judge-pod/<old tag> (new tag) checks the old fetched cache against the old result's recorded SHA-256 and its run record (cuda, this judge) at build time (judge_pod.resume_from :246-271), ships it in the bundle (resume/harmbench.jsonl), and the pod seeds its own cache from it before judging the rest (pod_job._seed_cache :155-166).
